name: render
summary: Offline-render a patch fixture with the native engine (WAV, event log, hashes, descriptors), and run golden tests: exact audio/event hashes for tests/golden/*.json, optionally across build configs.
usage: pnpm bd render tests/golden/emitter-tone.json --wav out.wav --events out.jsonl
outputs: JSON summary {audioHash, eventHash, events, rms, peak, ...}; tests/golden/expected/*.json on --update
